description: This file contains TypeScript code defining interfaces, types, and functions for handling AI course data, including fetching course details, limits, and lists of courses with various filters.

classes.name: AICourseProgressDocument
classes.description: Interface representing a user's progress in an AI course.

classes.name: AICourseModule
classes.description: Type representing a module within an AI course, including title and lessons.

classes.name: AICourseDocument
classes.description: Interface representing an AI course with details such as title, modules, and progress.

classes.name: AICourseWithLessonCount
classes.description: Type extending AICourseDocument with an additional lessonCount property.

methods.name: getAiCourseOptions
methods.description: Fetches options for a specific AI course based on its slug.

methods.name: aiLimitOptions
methods.description: Retrieves the current usage and limits for AI-related features.

methods.name: listUserAiCoursesOptions
methods.description: Lists AI courses associated with the logged-in user, with pagination and query options.

methods.name: listFeaturedAiCoursesOptions
methods.description: Lists featured AI courses with pagination.

methods.name: listExploreAiCoursesOptions
methods.description: Lists AI courses for exploration, with pagination and search query.
